controls_verified.implementation: os.open with O_CREAT | O_EXCL and mode 0o600 creates key files atomically with owner-only access.
verify_key_file_permissions and FileBackedKeyProvider reject symlinks unconditionally across all platforms.
Key ID regex ^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+$ and resolve().parent == key_dir prevent traversal attacks.
Production keys enforce minimum 32 bytes (256-bit entropy); test keys require 16 bytes.
SigningKeyRegistry.is_test_key rejects test keys for production operations.
redact_secret_string masks keys in all string representations, exceptions, and audit logs.
